evidence.log: 16-Oct 08:44:50 · app lcr_shell · user etl_owner · INSERT INTO core.fact_hqla (entity, hqla_level, mv_usd, haircut, weighted_usd) SELECT s.entity_code, CASE WHEN
evidence.sql:
INSERT INTO core.fact_hqla (entity, hqla_level, mv_usd, haircut, weighted_usd)
SELECT s.entity_code,
       CASE
         WHEN s.asset_class IN ('L1_SOVEREIGN', 'L1_CENTRAL_BANK') THEN '1'
         WHEN s.asset_class IN ('L2A_GOV', 'L2A_COVERED') THEN '2A'
         ELSE '2B'
       END AS hqla_level,
       SUM(s.mv_usd) AS mv_usd,
       p.factor AS haircut,
       SUM(s.mv_usd) * (1 - p.factor) AS weighted_usd
FROM stg.security_holding s
JOIN stg.lcr_param p
  ON p.item_code = 'HQLA_L' || CASE
         WHEN s.asset_class IN ('L1_SOVEREIGN', 'L1_CENTRAL_BANK') THEN '1'
         WHEN s.asset_class IN ('L2A_GOV', 'L2A_COVERED') THEN '2A'
         ELSE '2B'
       END
WHERE NOT s.is_encumbered
  AND s.asset_class IN ('L1_SOVEREIGN', 'L1_CENTRAL_BANK', 'L2A_GOV', 'L2A_COVERED', 'L2B_RMBS', 'L2B_CORP_BOND')
GROUP BY s.entity_code, 2, p.factor;

business_rules: factor looked up from lcr_param by item_code = 'HQLA_L' || CASE WHEN asset_class IN ('L1_SOVEREIGN', 'L1_CENTRAL_BANK') THEN '1' WHEN asset_class IN ('L2A_GOV', 'L2A_COVERED') THEN '2A' ELSE '2B' END
Summed by entity_code and hqla_level and factor
hops.transformation: Sums s.mv_usd grouped by s.entity_code, hqla_level, p.factor; filtered to NOT s.is_encumbered; filtered to s.asset_class IN ('L1_SOVEREIGN', 'L1_CENTRAL_BANK', 'L2A_GOV', 'L2A_COVERED', 'L2B_RMBS', 'L2B_CORP_BOND').
statement_rules: HQLA after haircut = SUM(Market value USD) × (1 - factor)

INSERT INTO core.fact_inflow (entity, category, balance_usd, inflow_rate, inflow_usd)
SELECT c.entity_code,
       c.flow_type AS category,
       SUM(c.amount_usd) AS balance_usd,
       p.factor AS inflow_rate,
       SUM(c.amount_usd) * p.factor AS inflow_usd
FROM stg.cashflow c
JOIN stg.lcr_param p

WHERE c.flow_type LIKE 'IN%'
  AND c.maturity_date > DATE '2026-06-30'
  AND c.maturity_date <= DATE '2026-07-30'
GROUP BY c.entity_code, c.flow_type, p.factor;

evidence.sql:
INSERT INTO core.fact_outflow (entity, category, balance_usd, runoff_rate, outflow_usd)
SELECT d.entity_code,
       CASE
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' AND d.insured THEN 'RET_STABLE'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' THEN 'RET_LESS_STABLE'
         WHEN d.is_operational THEN 'WHOLESALE_OPERATIONAL'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'FIN' THEN 'FIN_NON_OPERATIONAL'
         ELSE 'CORP_NON_OPERATIONAL'
       END AS category,
       SUM(d.balance_usd) AS balance_usd,
       p.factor AS runoff_rate,
       SUM(d.balance_usd) * p.factor AS outflow_usd
FROM stg.deposit_account d
JOIN stg.lcr_param p
  ON p.item_code = CASE
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' AND d.insured THEN 'RET_STABLE'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' THEN 'RET_LESS_STABLE'
         WHEN d.is_operational THEN 'WHOLESALE_OPERATIONAL'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'FIN' THEN 'FIN_NON_OPERATIONAL'
         ELSE 'CORP_NON_OPERATIONAL'
       END
GROUP BY d.entity_code, 2, p.factor;

business_rules: Stressed outflow = SUM(Deposit balance USD) × factor
Summed by entity_code and category and factor

SELECT d.entity_code,
       CASE
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' AND d.insured THEN 'RET_STABLE'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' THEN 'RET_LESS_STABLE'
         WHEN d.is_operational THEN 'WHOLESALE_OPERATIONAL'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'FIN' THEN 'FIN_NON_OPERATIONAL'
         ELSE 'CORP_NON_OPERATIONAL'
       END AS category,
       SUM(d.balance_usd) AS balance_usd,
       p.factor AS runoff_rate,
       SUM(d.balance_usd) * p.factor AS outflow_usd
FROM stg.deposit_account d
JOIN stg.lcr_param p
  ON p.item_code = CASE
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' AND d.insured THEN 'RET_STABLE'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'RETAIL' THEN 'RET_LESS_STABLE'
         WHEN d.is_operational THEN 'WHOLESALE_OPERATIONAL'
         WHEN d.cpty_type = 'FIN' THEN 'FIN_NON_OPERATIONAL'
         ELSE 'CORP_NON_OPERATIONAL'
       END
GROUP BY d.entity_code, 2, p.factor;

INSERT INTO rpt.lcr_summary (entity, hqla_usd, outflows_usd, inflows_usd, net_outflows_usd, lcr_pct)
SELECT h.entity,
       ROUND(h.hqla / 1000000, 2) AS hqla_usd,
       ROUND(o.outflows / 1000000, 2) AS outflows_usd,
       ROUND(i.inflows / 1000000, 2) AS inflows_usd,
       ROUND((o.outflows - LEAST(i.inflows, 0.75 * o.outflows)) / 1000000, 2) AS net_outflows_usd,
       ROUND(h.hqla / (o.outflows - LEAST(i.inflows, 0.75 * o.outflows)) * 100, 2) AS lcr_pct
FROM (SELECT entity, SUM(weighted_usd) AS hqla FROM core.fact_hqla GROUP BY entity) h
JOIN (SELECT entity, SUM(outflow_usd) AS outflows FROM core.fact_outflow GROUP BY entity) o
  ON o.entity = h.entity
JOIN (SELECT entity, SUM(inflow_usd) AS inflows FROM core.fact_inflow GROUP BY entity) i
  ON i.entity = h.entity;

CREATE VIEW "rpt"."v_lcr_summary" AS SELECT lcr_summary.entity,
    lcr_summary.hqla_usd,
    lcr_summary.outflows_usd,
    lcr_summary.inflows_usd,
    lcr_summary.net_outflows_usd,
    lcr_summary.lcr_pct
   FROM rpt.lcr_summary
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'GROUP'::text AS entity,
    sum(lcr_summary.hqla_usd) AS hqla_usd,
    sum(lcr_summary.outflows_usd) AS outflows_usd,
    sum(lcr_summary.inflows_usd) AS inflows_usd,
    sum(lcr_summary.net_outflows_usd) AS net_outflows_usd,
    round(((sum(lcr_summary.hqla_usd) / sum(lcr_summary.net_outflows_usd)) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS lcr_pct
   FROM rpt.lcr_summary
